name: @pryzm/solar-analysis
description: ADR-0074 (P1 L2 core) — pure, THREE-free solar sun-sampling + per-surface sun-hours ACCUMULATION math. Replicates the NOAA solar-position algorithm from core-app-model RealSunService (kept in sync; no THREE import) and generates deterministic SunSample sets, then accumulates per-surface sun-hours given an INJECTED occlusion oracle (the renderer-three GPU pass supplies the real one later; tests inject a mock). Zero I/O, no THREE, no DOM, no RNG, no Date.now — same inputs → identical output. The GPU shadow-map occlusion + heatmap render pass is a SEPARATE deferred slice in packages/renderer-three that consumes accumulateSunHours's isOccluded oracle and paints SunHoursResult.
